Name: Ultravisor — Secured (external auth, no in-app user mgmt)
Description: Ultravisor + ultravisor-auth-beacon running the ExternalDirectoryAuthProvider.  Simulates a deployment whose user store lives outside Ultravisor (LDAP, OIDC, in-house IAM): the beacon validates credentials and mints sessions, but the in-app user management views are HIDDEN because the provider advertises `UserManagement: external` at registration.  Use this preset as a fixture for the third login mode — verify that login works, the dashboard renders, AND the Users tab is absent from the top nav.

DataRoot.Description: Where Ultravisor + auth-beacon state persist on the host.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout. Ultravisor + auth-beacon are built from sibling checkouts at launch.

DirectoryUser.Description: Username for the simulated external directory's seed account.

DirectoryPassword.Description: Password for the seed external-directory account.  Username/password pairs are validated against this in-memory directory but treated as if they came from a remote IdP.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.
